title: Passive voice — is/are/has been + past participle
titleIt: Forma passiva — is/are/has been + participio passato
examples: A clear shift has been reported.
The results are discussed by managers.
pattern: Subject + be + past participle (+ by agent)
explanation: Use the passive when the action or result matters more than who did it, especially in reports.
explanationIt: Usa il passivo quando conta di più l'azione o il risultato rispetto a chi l'ha compiuta, soprattutto nei report.
realUse: A clear shift towards hybrid models has been reported.
The figures were published last week.
Further changes are expected next year.

options: A clear shift has been reported.
A clear shift been has reported.
A clear shift have been report.
exercises.answer: A clear shift has been reported.
exercises.explanation: Present perfect passive: has/have been + past participle.
